name: Berggasthof Bavaria
beschreibung: The Berggasthof Bavaria is located in the Tiroler mountains and offers accommodation with regional character. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished. The inn has a dining room where Tiroler Spezialitäten are served. From the terrace, you can enjoy a view of the surrounding mountains. The inn is suitable as a starting point for hikes and ski tours. The kitchen emphasizes local products. The atmosphere is rural and traditional.
